subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Scrape the barrel

options.text: Using all the ways to achieve the desired result
To be forced to use one's last and weakest resource

solution:
The correct answer is: **To be forced to use one's last and weakest resource.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**scrape the barrel**" means to use one's last and weakest resource.
